mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 2.0% for three consecutive months signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising labor force participation (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) signals tight labor markets that drive inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price inflation exceeding 3.5% annually (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25pp) and industrial production declines (INDPRO fall > 0.5% MoM) signal monetary tightening suppressing economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and INDPRO declines > 0.5% MoM in same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and INDPRO declines > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer spending regime (RSAFS > 500,000 million dollars), rising housing starts (HOUST > 1200 thousand units) indicate strong demand for goods and services, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: high consumer spending and housing boom
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 500000 and HOUST > 1200.
